## About
Ella Paint & Body Shop is a family owned body shop in Magnolia, built on word of mouth. As our site puts it, quality and honesty is the secret to our success.
Sonny B is a hands-on shop owner who deals personally with every part of the repair. After retiring from the Houston Fire Department, he went into the business full time. He will not compromise a repair, because he knows your family rides in the vehicles that leave this shop.
We handle collision repair, paint, frame and suspension work, alignments and leveling kits, and we work with your insurance company to bring your vehicle back to its pre-accident condition.

## Services
- Collision repair: One-on-one service from start to finish, including working with your insurance company on your repair.
- Waterborne paint: We are a PPG certified shop using a waterborne paint system.
- 2 & 4 wheel alignments: Wheel alignments for your car or truck.
- Leveling kit installation: Leveling kits installed on your truck or SUV.
- Towing: Towing is part of what we offer alongside collision repair and alignments. Call us to set it up.

## FAQ
Q: Will you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes. Our collision repair process includes working with your insurance company to restore your vehicle to its pre-accident condition.

Q: What are your hours?
A: We are open Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: No, we are closed Saturday and Sunday.
